name: notification-stack
title: Notification stack
author: Eduardo Retana
description: A depth stack of notices. Dismiss the front card and the next one steps forward.

meta.descriptionEs: Avisos en capas. Al descartar el de enfrente, el siguiente avanza.

examples.title: Pila
examples.description: Cuatro avisos. La palomita, Supr o Retroceso descartan el de enfrente.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: 320px, vacío, uno, cuarenta, RTL y un título sin espacios.

meta.usage:
<NotificationStack
  items={notices}
  onDismiss={(id) => setNotices((current) => current.filter((item) => item.id !== id))}
  onEmpty={() => setQuiet(true)}
/>

api.name: items / defaultItems
api.description: Pass items to control the list. Omit items and pass defaultItems for internal state. The first item is the front card.

api.name: onDismiss / onEmpty
api.description: onDismiss fires with the removed id. onEmpty fires when that dismiss clears the list.

api.name: onItemClick / renderAction
api.description: Optional body click and an action slot under the copy.

api.name: tone
api.description: Host chart or primary token for the icon tile, mixed with the background.

api.name: empty / emptyLabel
api.description: Shown when nothing is left. emptyLabel defaults to You're all caught up.

api.name: expandable
api.description: Show all fans the stack into a vertical list. Default true.

api.name: dismissOnEscape
api.description: Escape dismisses the focused card. Default true. Delete and Backspace always dismiss it.

api.name: dismissDistance
api.description: Pixels on +X that dismiss the front card. Default 88, about two 44px targets. Not a catalog-wide ratio.

api.name: dismissVelocity
api.description: px/s. A release this fast dismisses below dismissDistance when it moved toward +X. Default 640. Ignored under reduced motion.

api.name: rubberLimit
api.description: How far a drag toward -X can approach, in px. Default 96.

api.name: label / dismissLabel
api.description: Region name and the accessible name of the done button.

api.name: className / classNames
api.description: Root class and slot classes for the card, icon, title, body, time, dismiss, badge, depth, and empty state.

docs: A depth stack, separate from toast-stack (short results at the edge), notification-center (a grouped list with read state), and card-stack (a left-or-right triage deck). Up to three cards peek above the front one. Only the front card is interactive. The swipe is +X, the same axis an expanded row enters on. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite button. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors. With reduced motion the finger still tracks and the release jumps, with no spring. Gesture track follows Emil Kowalski, emilkowalski/skills@715c180 skills/gestures (MIT). Visual inspiration is a Facebook reel by Design & Code With AV (Notification Stack UI Upgrade). No code from that reel was used.
